name: statusline-pace
description: A pace band above the prompt: Claude 5h/7d windows on row 1 for any model, OpenCode Go and z.ai windows on the rows below, with run-out and reset ETAs.

showModel.title: Show the model
showModel.description: Show the model and effort (Opus high) at the start of the band.

showContext.title: Show context fill
showContext.description: Show the context window fill (ctx 34%) after the windows on row 1.

stateFile.title: Plan state file
stateFile.description: Path to a windows.json for the Go (plans.go) and z.ai (plans.zai) rows and the Claude fallback (plans.claude or subscription); ~ allowed. Empty = off.
